en: The image shows a colorized photograph of large, red-brick ruins surrounded by lush trees and a landscaped park. The ruins appear to be the remnants of fortress or castle walls, now overgrown with some vegetation. Several people in early 20th-century attire are strolling along the pathways. In the bottom right, there is printed text in a script that appears to be Latvian.
